# --- software-engineering TOOLCHAIN (pinned by version and SHA-256) -------------
# The language kernel above gives parsers and solvers. These are the tools the
# capability adapters execute: the full-suite gate runs `pytest`, and the review
# gates shell out to mypy / ruff / bandit / coverage. Measured on 35265c5 with none
# of them installed: python.repo.diff_apply_full_testgate.v1 could not pass by
# construction, and diff_type_gate / diff_static_triage / diff_security_gate /
# diff_coverage_gate degraded to PASS_*_ONLY. pytest==9.1.1 is the version
# .github/workflows/full-private-current-main-regression.yml already pins.
# This section is added by hand, hash-computed from the wheels pip resolves for
# cp311 / manylinux2014_x86_64; `pip install --require-hashes` verifies every byte.
